title: Fix Nam Jap count saving, add Radha Nam & Jai Shree Ram options, and add animations

requirements.summary: Add Radha Nam (राधा नाम) and Jai Shree Ram (जय श्री राम) as selectable mantra/name options in the Nam Jap page
acceptanceCriteria: Radha Nam (राधा नाम) option appears in the name/mantra selector on the Jap page
Jai Shree Ram (जय श्री राम) option appears in the name/mantra selector on the Jap page
Selecting either option updates the displayed mantra name and the Jap counter context
Previously existing mantra options remain functional

file_operations.description: Add Radha Nam and Jai Shree Ram as selectable mantra options in the mantra selector UI. Update the mantra display logic to show the selected mantra name in both Hindi and transliteration. Ensure the mantra selection state updates the Jap counter context with the selected mantra. The backend already defines radhaNamJap and jaiShreeRamNamJap in the Mantra enum, so wire these options into the frontend selector dropdown/list alongside existing mantras like hareKrishna, omNamahShivaya, etc.

requirements.summary: Fix Nam Jap count persistence with localStorage for guest users and backend sync for authenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: Jap count persists in localStorage so refreshing the page does not reset the count for guest users
For authenticated users, the Jap count is saved to the backend canister and restored on page load
Switching between mantras saves and restores the correct count per mantra
Count is not lost when navigating away from the Jap page and returning

file_operations.description: Implement dual-persistence logic for the Jap count: (a) For guest (unauthenticated) users, save the count per mantra to localStorage on each increment and restore from localStorage on page load. Use a localStorage key structure like 'jap_count_<mantraName>' to store counts separately per mantra. (b) For authenticated users, continue using the existing backend incrementJap and getJapStats queries/mutations, and ensure the count is fetched from the backend on mount and synced on increment. Add useEffect hooks to handle restoration from localStorage when the user is not authenticated, and to restore from backend JapStats when authenticated. Ensure switching mantras retrieves the correct persisted count for that mantra. The existing debounced backend sync in Jap.tsx should remain for authenticated users; add localStorage writes for guest users immediately on count changes.

requirements.summary: Add meaningful animations to the Nam Jap page: ripple on tap, entrance animations, and celebratory animation on 108 completion
acceptanceCriteria: Each tap on the Jap count button triggers a visible ripple or glow pulse animation on the button
The mala ring and counter display animate in smoothly when the Jap page first loads
Completing 108 counts triggers a celebratory visual animation (light burst, petal shower, or similar devotional effect)
Animations are smooth and do not cause layout shifts or performance degradation

file_operations.description: Add entrance animations for the mala ring and counter display when the Jap page first loads using CSS transitions or Tailwind animation classes (e.g., fade-in, slide-up). On each tap of the Jap count button, trigger the existing SacredRipple component by incrementing its trigger prop, and optionally add a brief scale or glow pulse effect using Tailwind classes or inline animations. On completing 108 counts (when count % 108 === 0 and count > 0), trigger the existing LotusBloomOverlay component to display a celebratory lotus bloom animation. Ensure all animations are smooth and do not block the UI thread or cause layout shifts.

Ensure the SacredRipple component renders concentric ripple rings that expand and fade out smoothly on each trigger. Verify the animation duration and easing provide a visually pleasing ripple effect suitable for the devotional context. No major changes needed if the existing implementation is sufficient; otherwise, refine the animation timing or styling.

Ensure the LotusBloomOverlay component displays a full-screen celebratory animation (lotus bloom image with a congratulatory message) when triggered. Verify the animation auto-hides after a short duration and does not interfere with further Jap counting. Confirm the existing implementation uses the generated lotus bloom asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/lotus-bloom.dim_400x400.png. No major changes needed if the existing implementation is sufficient.
